 Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka Live Score, ODI Tri-Series Final: Salman Agha Gives Hosts First Breakthrough | SL 89/1 (18)
 D Deepak Joshi Minal Tomar Updated on: 31 October 2026 2:57 pm Published at: 31 October 2026 2:57 pm Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Live Score: Catch all the action as it happened from the Pakistan vs Sri Lanka ODI in the 2026 Tri-Series at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore
 Prefer on Google D Deepak Joshi Minal Tomar Updated on: 31 October 2026 2:57 pm Published at: 31 October 2026 2:57 pm Pakistan's Shaheen Shah Afridi, second from right, celebrates with teammates after the dismissal of Sri Lanka's Avishka Fernando during the tri-series one-day international cricket match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka, in Lahore, Pakistan, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. | Photo: AP/K.M. Chaudary PAK Vs SL Live Score, ODI Tri-Series Final: Pakistan will face Sri Lanka in the final of the ODI Tri-Series 2026 at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore on Saturday, October 31, with both teams eyeing the trophy. Led by Shaheen Shah Afridi, Pakistan will look to bounce back after suffering an eight-wicket defeat against Sri Lanka in their previous meeting on October 27, when they were bowled out for just 110. Kusal Mendis' Sri Lanka, meanwhile, enter the final after a 55-run defeat against England, despite scoring 331 while chasing 387. Pakistan will rely on Salman Ali Agha, the hosts' leading run-scorer with 158 runs, and tournament joint-leading wicket-taker Shaheen, who has eight scalps. Arafat Minhas has also impressed with nine wickets. With Pavan Rathnayake leading the tournament's run charts, Sri Lanka will fancy their chances of upsetting the hosts. The match begins at 1:30 PM IST. LIVE UPDATES 31 Oct 2026, 02:56:46 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Salman Agha Provides Breakthrough!
 Salman Ali Agha finally breaks the opening partnership, trapping Avishka Fernando lbw for 38 off 49 balls after Pakistan's bowlers built pressure with a maiden over.
 Fernando goes for a sweep but misses a straight delivery, and ball-tracking confirms it would have hit leg stump. Kusal Mendis walks in next.

 31 Oct 2026, 02:43:16 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Fernando, Mendis Shift Gears!
 Sri Lanka have finally shifted gears after a cautious start, with Avishka Fernando and Kamindu Mendis finding the boundaries and building momentum.
The opening pair continues to frustrate Pakistan, keeping the scoreboard ticking and laying a solid platform for the latter stages.
 SL 84/0 (15) 
 31 Oct 2026, 02:20:25 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Hosts Badly Need A Wicket Now!
 Pakistan continue to keep the scoring rate in check, with Arafat Minhas delivering another economical over.
Avishka Fernando and Kamindu Mendis have looked comfortable at the crease but are yet to shift gears and put the bowlers under pressure.
 SL 55/0 (11) 
 31 Oct 2026, 02:13:01 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Mendis, Fernando Looking Set!
 Sri Lanka continue to build their innings steadily without losing a wicket. The openers have added 43 runs in the first nine overs, maintaining a scoring rate of 4.78. Pakistan have managed to keep the boundaries in check, but will be desperate to break this opening partnership. Sri Lanka are off to a cautious start in the final.
 SL 43/0 (9) 
 31 Oct 2026, 01:55:55 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Shaheen Afridi & Bowlers Searching For Wickets!
 Pakistan continue to keep Sri Lanka's openers quiet as Naseem Shah delivers another disciplined over. Just six runs come off the fourth over, with Avishka Fernando and Kamindu Mendis struggling to find boundaries and accelerate the scoring. Naseem has been particularly impressive, conceding only nine runs in his two overs without picking up a wicket.
 SL 16/0 (4) 
 31 Oct 2026, 01:38:56 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Captain Shaheen Starts Well!
 A steady start from Sri Lanka, but Shaheen Shah Afridi keeps things tight in the opening over! Avishka Fernando manages just two runs from six deliveries as Pakistan's captain starts with a disciplined spell, conceding only two runs. Kamindu Mendis is yet to face a ball.

 Pakistan won the toss and opted to bowl first!
 31 Oct 2026, 12:50:05 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: Concers for SL!
 Sri Lanka's batting has been explosive throughout the tournament, but their lower-order collapses remain a concern. While Pavan Rathnayake and Kusal Mendis have delivered big runs, the inability of the tail to contribute could prove costly in the final.
 31 Oct 2026, 12:16:31 pm IST Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final, Live Score: SL Coming With Confidence!
 Sri Lanka will take confidence from their dominant eight-wicket victory over Pakistan in their previous meeting on October 27. Pakistan were bundled out for just 110 in 25.3 overs, with Dilshan Madushanka claiming a career-best 5/34. In response, Kamindu Mendis led the chase with an unbeaten 62 as Sri Lanka cruised to 114/2 in just 18.1 overs. Pakistan will be eager to turn the tables in today's final.

 Pakistan Vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series Final Live streaming is not available for the fans in India, however, there are reports that suggests the match can be streamed live on VETO app.

 Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Pakistan vs Sri Lanka ODI Tri-Series 2026 final! Shaheen Shah Afridi's Pakistan take on Kusal Mendis-led Sri Lanka at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Pakistan will be eager to clinch the title on home soil, while Sri Lanka will look to repeat their dominant league-stage victory over the hosts.
